# vrEmu6502 provenance

- Upstream: https://github.com/visrealm/vrEmu6502
- Commit: `aae98cb14386d832cb7357c99626520b6590bc24`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`
- Imported files: `src/vrEmu6502.c`, `src/vrEmu6502.h`, and `LICENSE`

The imported source and header are byte-for-byte copies of the Git blobs at
the pinned commit. MHS Power Engine selects `CPU_6510`, which includes the
NMOS 6510 undocumented opcodes required by C64 software.
